title: NGI CartoWeb.be topographic WMS
note: The national topographic base map: topo and topo_grey, their cross-border variants, and a labels-and-symbols overlay. NGI's INSPIRE Annex I service carries only themed vector layers, so this is where the readable general-purpose map of Belgium comes from. A WMTS of the same five layers exists at cartoweb.wmts.ngi.be, but the harvester only reads WMS capabilities documents.
